verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev provides built-in observability (run traces, states, Limits/concurrency usage page) and can alert via email, Slack, and webhooks when tasks fail, which covers the alerting half of the story. However, there is no evidence of exporting metrics (failure rates, latencies, queue depths) to external observability stacks like Prometheus, Datadog, or via OpenTelemetry — only proprietary dashboard views and webhook-based alerts are documented, and no OpenAPI/metrics export endpoint was found by probes. missing for 10: OpenTelemetry or Prometheus-compatible metrics export, documented integration with third-party observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana), independent confirmation that webhook alerts feed into external monitoring pipelines.
